decisions.why: examples (AER Auto Plus alternating air mattress, seclusion/custodial mattresses) are mattresses and hybrid alternating-air systems
examples (AER Pump, AER Fusion, AER Magna) are the alternating-pressure mattress pump/system components of the same AER mattress range listed under the Mattresses division
examples (gel pad, memory foam waterproof cushion, gel pad replacement) are pressure-relieving seating cushions
examples (Integrity High/Low Back Chairs) are specialist care seating
examples (underlays for pressure care & mattress protection, pressure relief overlay) are mattress overlays, matching the 'overlays and positioning' type
sole example Seclusion Mattress is a mattress product
sole example Heel Trough PU Mattress Extension is a positioning accessory attached to a mattress, matching 'mattresses, overlays and positioning'
named products (Standard/Folding Fall Mat) are positioning/cushioning floor surfaces, the nearest existing type to a fall mat, per Lou's steer on this range
named product (Anti Vandal Safe Bed Surround) is a bed accessory, matching beds, cots & profiling frames
